text: Nde Iisaa (jom kisiyee) on ardannoo yimɓe makko ɓen hujjaaji ɓannginɗi Nulala makko ngal, o maakani ɓe: Gomɗii mi ardanii on e ñeeñal immorde ka Allah, e no ɓannginirana on yoga e ko luutondirɗon e mun, ka diina mon. Haray huliree Allah, ɗoftagol yamiraaɗi Makko ɗin, e woɗɗitagol haɗaaɗi Makko ɗin. Ɗofton mi e ko yamirta on kon, rentoɗon e ko mi haɗi on e mun kon.
